title: Find the Regression
description: The latest version contains BUG_TRIGGER=true. Version 2 was known good, and the current HEAD is bad.
mission: Use Git history or git bisect to find the first bad commit and write its full hash into answer.txt.
success: You identified the commit that introduced the regression.
solution: git bisect start; git bisect bad; git bisect good HEAD~3

lesson.what_happened: Binary search through history isolated the first commit containing the regression.
other_solutions: Inspect every diff in a small history
lesson.be_careful: Reset the bisect session with git bisect reset when finished.

hints: Inspect the app.env history and diffs.
git bisect needs a known bad and known good revision.
The first bad commit is the one that first adds BUG_TRIGGER=true.
